important_semantics: Each step normally passes on process exit zero. Declared report files must exist and parse as JSON objects. Prerequisite failures block dependent steps; unrelated steps continue so a failed early step does not mean later logs are absent. A blocked/unavailable step cannot count as executed.

Only named generated examples are excluded from the isolated-workspace immutable-input comparison; original checkout bytes are still protected.
